final: WITH total_members AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM member), major_counts AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(mem.member_id) as member_count FROM major m LEFT JOIN member mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), major_shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_members) as share FROM major_counts), dept_avg_shares AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) as dept_avg_share FROM major_shares GROUP BY department), filtered AS (SELECT ms.major_id, ms.department, ms.member_count, ms.share, ms.share - das.dept_avg_share as difference FROM major_shares ms JOIN dept_avg_shares das ON ms.department = das.department WHERE ms.share > das.dept_avg_share) SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
